Source: https://github.com/facebook/fishhook (main).
License: BSD 3-Clause; see fishhook-LICENSE and source headers.

and comparing each file byte-for-byte; no differences. No local modifications.


On update, compare upstream code and license, record the new hash/date here,
then run ./patch.sh --test. A successful rebind_symbols return is not evidence
that every image or future OS is supported. Real account acceptance is separate.
